Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Ireland players are in the huddle and they disperse now to take their respective positions. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen are the openers for New Zealand. Mark Adair will start with the ball for Ireland. Two slips in place. Martin Guptill on strike. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, Ireland have put a good total on the board. However, they need to bowl well here as this is quite a high-scoring ground and Kiwis have some quality batters in their line-up. Can Ireland bowlers defend this total? We shall find out after the break. Stay tuned...

Harry Tector is down for a quick chat. He says all his family and friends are here so it is very special for him. Adds that his granny passed away last week so this is a bit of a joyous moment after the tragedy. Mentions that his celebration after getting his ton was more about relief and is happy to have performed for his team. Reckons that the start is always tricky but they have a decent score but will have to bowl well.

New Zealand will be disappointed with their bowling effort, especially after the start they got. Both Henry and Ferguson were brilliant with the new ball but Kiwi bowlers failed to maintain that pressure in the middle overs. Ferguson though kept his good work going in with the older ball as well compared to Henry who could not put much pressure after his first spell. The debutant, Glenn Phillips provided an important breakthrough by getting rid of Campher in his second over. Sodhi though was expensive and it was only at the back end that he and Blair Tickner came into their own and Ireland who were cruising at 241-4 were reduced to 253-7. Ferguson, Tickner and Sodhi all finished with 2 wickets each but they could not stop Ireland from reaching that 300-run mark.

Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are two of the most experienced and important batters for Ireland. However, they were back in the hut quite early with Ireland struggling at 26-2 in the seventh over. Then came the resurgence as Harry Tector and Andy McBrine stitched together a steady stand of 60 runs to bring some solidity in the Irish innings. Andy McBrine departed but Tector continued and found the able partner in the form of Curtis Campher. The duo put together a brisk and very effective stand of 94 before Campher departed. Tector though was in no mood to let this opportunity go as he notched up his first ODI century and along with Tucker lifted the scoring rate quite swiftly. There was a mini-collapse towards the end but Simi Singh and George Dockrell ensured that runs kept coming and Ireland have eventually managed a very good total here.

A very fine batting effort from Ireland! They have managed to reach 300 here and they will take this with both hands especially after losing some early wickets. The pitch though is very good and New Zealand will fancy their chances of chasing this total down. It is upto the Irish bowlers now to back up this good work by their batters and it’s surely is game on here at Malahide.

OUT! RUN OUT! Craig Young pushes hard for two and at this point, it is worth a shot but he's never making it. Back of a length, around off and this is tucked away towards mid-wicket. The batters pick up a single as the bowler, Blair Tickner chases it down. Young looks for two but Singh knows it isn't on and doesn't bother to run. Tickner throws it back to the keeper and Tom Latham whips off the bails. Ireland finish with a score of 300/9!
Simi Singh tries to be cheeky but it will be a dot ball. Slower one, fuller and well outside off. Singh looks to reverse it past the keeper but doesn't connect.
Bye.! This is dug in short and outside off, Craig Young tries to take it on but makes no connection. Simi Singh calls him for a bye and the batters race through for it.
Length again, around off. This is played off the back foot towards deep cover for one.
Craig Young is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bowled on a length and outside off, George Dockrell steps out and opens the face of the bat to lift this one over the cover fence. Dockrell though ends up slicing it high and towards the point fence. Glenn Phillips over there takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, around the top of off, George Dockrell looks to thrash it through covers but fails to connect.
Blair Tickner to bowl the last over!

FOUR! Important runs for Ireland here and Simi Singh is taking his side ever so close to the 300-run mark. This is pushed wider, Singh steps out again and ends up slicing this one over backward point for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Just over! Length again, on middle, Singh gives himself some room and throws his hands at it. Singh gets enough on it to clear a jumping Michael Bracewell and picks up a boundary.
Full and outside off, this is jammed out towards covers by Dockrell for one.
Length this time, sliding into middle and leg, this is wristed away through square leg for just a run.
Slower delivery, bowled into the pitch. Simi Singh advances looking to swat it away but ends up getting it nowhere.
Goes very full and angles it in on leg stump, Dockrell flicks it away to deep backward square leg and picks up a single.
Looks for the yorker on off stump but ends up serving a low full toss, George Dockrell drills it down to long off for a run. Ireland eyeing the 300-run mark now.
On middle, Singh clips it away through square leg for one more.
Back of a length, outside off, this is played uppishly towards sweeper cover for just a single.
Good length, around off, Dockrell looks to slap it away but misses.

Top edge and four! Lockie Ferguson touches almost 147 KPH and bangs it in at the body, George Dockrell has no idea what to do and dangles a bat at it. The ball goes off the top edge and over short third man for a boundary.
Full and around off, this is sweetly punched to the left of the man at mid off for a single.
This is dug in short, Singh walks towards the ball and pulls it well in front of square on the leg side for a single. 13 off the over, a good one for Ireland.
SIX! One hand off the handle and lofted over the ropes! Length ball from Henry, Simi Singh steps out and lifts this one over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
Full and on off, Singh dances down the track and drives it straight towards cover.
There seems to be some issue with the ball! The problem is sorted now and we are ready to resume.
FOUR! In the air but flying past the man. A low full toss, around off, Simi Singh shuffles across and ramps it past Ish Sodhi at short fine leg and finds the fence.
Good length, on off stump, George Dockrell plays a checked lofted drive towards long on for a run.
A high full toss to start with, outside off. Singh punches it towards sweeper cover for just a single.
Matt Henry is back on.
This is very full and outside off. George Dockrell makes room but ends up backing away a bit too much. He offers no shot in the end as the ball is wider outside off.
SIX! Good shot! This is full on off. George Dockrell makes room and tonks it over long off for a biggie. Brilliantly played.
Lands on a length, on middle. Singh works it to backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Cracking shot! It is full and outside off. Singh drives it through extra-cover for a boundary.

LBW given! Singh takes DRS again! The decision is reversed again as the UltraEdge shows that the ball has hit the bat. It is a yorker on middle. Singh tries to dig it but gets the inside edge onto his pads. Lockie Ferguson appeals and the umpire agrees but only to reverse his decsion after the replays show otherwise.
A fuller delivery on off. George Dockrell drives it to mid off for a single.
Tossed up on off. Singh drives it to the bowler.

Singh has been given out caught behind here, he has taken a review though! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the impact is outside off. So the decision will be overturned. Coming to the ball - It is another googly, around off. Singh looks to defend it off the front foot. However, the ball misses his blade and brushes his pads on the way to the keeper. New Zealand appeal and the finger is raised. However, the decison is reversed in the end.
Simi Singh is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Another wicket falls down and New Zealand are pulling things back nicely here. This is a big spinning googly by Sodhi that pitches around off. It is slightly shorter in length and Mark Adair looks to pull it. The ball turns in sharply and shatters the stumps.
Shorter and outside off. Mark Adair looks to cut it but misses.
Slower through the air again, outside off. Mark Adair looks to sweep it but misses.
Tossed up, around off. George Dockrell drills it to long off for a single.
Shorter and outside off. George Dockrell cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Mark Adair is in at number 8.

OUT! CAUGHT! Harry Tector departs but after playing a superb knock for his team. Shorter-length delivery, outside off. It is an off -pace delivery and Tector looks to upper cut it. However, he gets a top edge and the ball loops up in the air towards point. Martin Guptill takes an easy catch and Harry Tector walks back to a standing ovation.
Commentary.Howout: c Martin Guptill b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Lands on a length, outside off. Tector goes chasing for it but misses.
Very full and outside off. Tector looks to get a bat on it but misses.
SIX! This time he sends it over the fence! A fullish delivery on off. Tector gets under it and tonks it over wide long on for a maximum.
FOUR! Tector just continues to find boundaries! This is an overpitched delivery, outside off. Tector drives it through covers for a boundary.
George Dockrell walks in to bat in his 100th ODI match.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a brilliant catch from Michael Bracewell! Absolutely stunning and that brings the end of Tucker's innings, a much-needed breakthrough for New Zealand! Tossed up around off. Tucker looks to launch it over long off. However, he does not get enough power behind that shot and ends up hitting it towards long off. Michael Bracewell who first misjudges it a bit pulls out his right hand and takes a one-handed stunner!
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and around off. Tector cuts it to point and takes a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Tucker pushes it to long on for a single.
WIDE! This is pushed wider of the off stump and turning away, Tucker looks to drive but misses and a wide is called.
Tossed up, around off. Tector drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
This is pushed outside off. Tector drives it towards the point fielder.
A flatter one on off. Tucker defends it out.

FOUR! WOW! What a shot, fourth boundary in a row and that is a century number 1 in ODI cricket for Harry Tector! Takes off his helmet and punches in the air in delight, a top-class knock from a top-class player. This is full and outside off again. Tector just leans forward and caresses it through the extra-cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Three in a row now! An half-volley, outside off. Tector drives it through covers firmly for another boundary.
FOUR! This is even better! On the shorter side, on off. Tector heaves it and splits the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on to perfection. Brilliant shot!
FOUR! Wonderful shot again by Tector! Tickner with a length delivery, around off. Tector skips down the track and creams it through extra-cover for a boundary.
Short and outside off. Tector looks to cut it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Tector dabs it towards point.
Blair Tickner (7-0-42-0) is brought back into the attack.
Slightly shorter again and outside off. It turns away a bit and beats Tucker as he looks to cut it.
Shorter and outside off. Tector cuts it to covers for a single.
A fuller delivery, around off. Tucker sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Massive hit! Tossed up on off. Tucker reaches the pitch of the ball and tonks it over long on for a biggie. Sodhi has been quite expensive today.
FOUR! Clever from Tucker! Tossed up on off. Tucker kneels and reverse-sweeps it past short third man for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and around off. Tector chops it to cover-point for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
On a good length, angling into the body, Tucker nudges it away towards mid-wicket.
Very full on off, ends up being a low full toss and bowled at around 145 clicks. Lorcan Tucker punches it towards mid off.
A touch fuller, at 142.5 KPH and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
Full and on the pads, this is swung away towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Around the top of off, Tucker solidly defends it out.
This is dug in short and at the body, Tucker manages to get it away past square leg and races back for the second.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and on off, Tector hammers this one back over the bowler's head to pick up yet another boundary. 17 off the over, a huge one for Ireland.
WIDE! Sodhi tries to attack the pads but spills it down leg, Tector misses the swing and a wide is called.
FOUR! What a shot! Tossed up, wide of the off stump, Harry Tector just goes inside-out and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Tector will feel he missed out there! In the slot, around and begging to be hit, Tector gets low and goes a bit too hard at it, ends up getting an inside edge back onto the pads.
This is flighted again, on middle, Tucker swings it away towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
SIX! Brilliant connection and it goes all the way! Flighted ball, around off, Lorcan Tucker gets low and fetches it from outside off to muscle it over the man at the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Shorter in length, around off. Tector eases it through point and rotates the strike.
Good pace again from Ferguson, keeping it on the shorter side and at the stumps. Tucker hops back but fails to get it away.
Fuller and trying to attack the pads, Lorcan Tucker looks to flick it away but the ball goes off the pads towards the keeper.
On the shorter side, at 146.2 KPH and angling it into the body. Tucker looks to work it leg side but gets beaten for pace and takes a blow on the body.
Short of a good length and over middle, Tector tucks it away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full and straight, pushed firmly back towards the bowler who manages to get a hand on it.
Ferguson sees Harry Tector advancing and digs it in short and around the rib cage, Tector keeps it down on the leg side.
Lockie Ferguson is back on. Six overs for 19 runs along with two wickets so far for the pacer.
Another wrong 'un, on a length and kept out nicely by Tucker.
On off and turning away, Tucker watches it closely and just nudges it past the man at first slip to pick up a couple of runs.
Nicely flighted, it is the wrong 'un too. Lorcan Tucker gets tempted into the cover drive against the spin but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg.
A touch short and wide, cut away to deep point for a single by Harry Tector.
Here comes the googly, turning into middle and leg, Tucker pushes it down to long on for one.
Slower through the air and on the shorter side, this is worked well in front of mid-wicket for an easy single.
Ish Sodhi is back into the attack now. Five overs for 21 runs so far.
On off, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Lorcan Tucker is the next man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Gem of a delivery from Glenn Phillips and he gets a wicket on his ODI debut, a big one too. This is quicker again, over 95 KPH and fuller, turning in sharply from around off. Curtis Campher doesn't read the length well and rocks back, looking to cut it away but the stumps were exposed and Campher was hurried on in the end. The ball goes on to hit the top of middle stump and New Zealand have broken the partnerhsip.
Straighter this time from Phillips, Tector turns it past square leg for a run.
This is fired in on off stump, Tector pushes it out on the off side.
Around middle and leg, swung away with the turn by Campher and on the bounce to the man at deep backward square leg for just a single.
Quicker delivery, turning in from around off. This is tapped away towards cover-point.

An appeal for an LBW but a big inside edge there! Lands on a length, on off and it nips back in slightly. Campher who looks to defend gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is an appeal from the bowler but in the meanwhile batters cross for a single. The umpire along with his other teammates are not interested.

FOUR! This time it goes off the middle of his blade! A fullish delivery, around off. It is not an half-volley by any stretch of imagination. However, Campher leans forward nicely and caresses it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing now for Ireland! Short and wide outside off. Campher slashes at it and slashes hard. The ball goes off the thick outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Tad shorter, around off. Tector skips down the track and dabs it left of point for a single.
A length delivery again, around off. Campher drives but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
Lands on a length, around off. Campher looks to drive it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.

DRINKS! Ireland have gone from a position of uncertainty in the first 10 overs to a position of real promise. Harry Tector has been the star for them so far and is looking to be on course of the hundred-run mark. Curtis Campher is looking in fine knick too and the Kiwi bowlers have a big job at hand. All the good work at the start seems to have vanished and apart from Lockie Ferguson no one really seems to be bothering the Irish batters. A fascinating passage of play awaits.

FOUR LEG BYES! So an expensive start from Glenn Phillips here! This is pushed quicker but it difts down the leg side. Tector looks to clip it but the ball misses his blade and brushes his pads. It runs towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A flatter delivery on off. Tector pushes it towards the off side.
SIX! Superb shot from Tector and what a clean hit this is! A fuller delivery on middle. Tector skips down the track and hits it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Pushes it quicker and flatter on off at 92.8 kph. Tector blocks it off the back foot.
It is fuller again on off. This time Campher drives it to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Campher pushes it towards covers.
Glenn Phillips, the ODI debutant to roll his arm now.
Goes fuller again but outside off. Tector drives it firmly towards the cover fielder in the ring.
A fullish delivery on middle again. Campher drives it to mid on and takes a single.
Fuller delivery on middle. Campher drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Campher is getting into his groove here! Henry bangs it short on middle. Campher pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Goes fuller on middle. Campher clips it to mid-wicket.
Lands on a length, on off. Campher defends it from his crease.
Well bowled! Comes 'round the wicket and angles it across the batter, outside off. Tector looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Another boundary! Fuller delivery, around off. Tector gets low and sweeps it in front of square for a boundary.
On the shorter side on middle. Tector works it to short mid-wicket.
A flatter one on off. Tector blocks it out.
WIDE! Turning into the batter again but it drifts down the leg side. Tector looks to clip it but misses.
Turning into leg. Campher tries to work it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes square off the wicket on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
SIX! Great use of the feet from Campher! Tossed up, around off. Campher dances down the track and tonks it over long off for a maximum.
Bit outside off this time and Campher guides this length delivery towards third man for a single.
Keeps it a tad short on off. Campher punches it back to the bowler.
Serves it on a length, on off. Campher blocks it from his crease.
Back of a length, around off. Tector just defends it with soft hands towards the off side and takes a quick single.
Lands on a length, on off. Tector blocks it solidly.
FOUR! Henry is greeted with a boundary in his first ball of a new spell! It is full on middle. Tector skips down the track a bit and clips it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Matt Henry comes back into the attack.
Fuller and on middle, driven straight to the man at mid on.
Leg bye! Attacking the pads, Tector misses the tuck and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg. The batters sneak in a quick leg bye.
Quicker and flatter, around off. This is played off the back foot through covers for one.
FOUR! Cheeky from Curtis Campher! On off, Campher just strides across the off stump and scoops it past the keeper and beats the man at the fine leg fence to pick up a boundary.
Length ball, drifted onto the pads, this is just tickled away towards fine leg for a single.
Turning it in from off stump, Harry Tector goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't quite get the timing right.
Much better over from Tickner this time around, just the two singles off it. Hard length again, over off, Campher gets behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Tector advances, Tickner pulls back the length but the former manages to just run it down to third man with soft hands and picks up a single.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Campher tucks it past square leg and collects a run.
Tickner hits the deck hard and bowls it around off, Campher looks to cut but is beaten for pace.
Good stop! Back of a length and around off, Campher punches it off the back foot but can't get it past the man at backward point.
Short and wide, Curtis Campher taps it on the bounce to the man at point. Campher will feel he missed out there.
Bowls this one very full and on middle, Tector nudges it onto the leg side.

Harry Tector races back for the second that's the FIFTY up for him, a very well-compiled knock so far. Flatter delivery, around off, this is cut away behind square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Floats it up, on a length and on off stump. Tector just defends it back towards the bowler.
On a length, around middle, this is tucked away towards square leg.
Fuller and on middle, pushed away past the man at mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter delivery, outside off, Tector just runs it down to the left of short third man for a single. Tector moves to 49 now.
Shorter in length and just a bit too straight, Harry Tector pulls it down to fine leg for one more.
Dug in a bit short and slower in pace, Campher works it past square leg and picks up a single.
Back of a length, on the body, Tector tucks it away towards deep backward square leg for a run.
On a good length, close to the off pole, this is tapped away towards point.
FOUR! Really well-controlled by Harry Tector. The attempted knuckle ball turns out to be a dipping full toss around off, Tector just caresses it through wide mid on and finds the fence.
Hard length, a fair bit outside off. This is slashed away down to third man for a single.
Around off, sweetly stroked away by Campher towards sweeper cover for one more.
A bit on the shorter and just too straight, Tector works it around the corner off the back foot and rotates the strike.
Turning it into middle off a length, Campher backs away and cuts it through point for a single.
Flighted this time, on off, Curtis Campher pushes it to the left of the bowler who makes a good diving stop.
On middle and leg, this is clipped away straight to the man at square leg.
Floated up around off stump, this is pushed away towards covers.
Lands just short of good length, around off. Campher waits for it and then guides it towards third man. A single taken.
On the shorter side on off. Tector pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Tector rides the bounce and defends it towards the off side.
SIX! Excellent shot! A length delivery on off. Tector dances down the track and launches it straight down the ground for a maximum. Tector showing his class yet again here.
A short delivery, around off. Campher pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Tector drives it to sweeper cover for a single. 100 up for Ireland!
Blair Tickner (4-0-22-0) is back on.
Pulls the length back a bit, on off. Campher with a solid block off the front foot.
FOUR! Beautifully played! This is overpitched, around off. Campher with a stylish drive through covers for a boundary.
This is fuller and outside off. Campher sweeps it to backward square leg.
Nicely bowled, tossed up on off. Campher defends it off the front foot.
Goes slightly fuller on middle. Tector clips it to wide long on for a single.
On off and fuller. Tector defends it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, around off. Tector guides it towards third man for a single. Just a single from the over.
Ferguson bowls a bouncer on middle. Tector has no interest in going after this ball and ducks underneath it.
Hard length again, around off. Tector pushes it gently towards the off side.
Tight line again, a length delivery on off. Tector blocks it out.
Lands on a length, on off. Tector defends it and the ball rolls behind the sticks but is bit away from the stumps.
Bangs it short on off. Terctor decides to duck under it.
Goes fuller on middle. Campher drives it to mid on this time.
Pitches it on middle and it turns into the batter again. Campher tucks it to backward square leg.
Turning into middle. Tector works it to square leg for a single.
Quicker and flatter on off. Tector pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up on middle. Tector skips down the track and chips it wide of long on for a boundary. The oufield is very quick and though the fielder in the deep makes a valiant effort to stop it, he really had not chance there.
Tossed up on middle. Campher works it right of mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Goes fuller this time on middle.Tector drives it to mid on. End of a successful over from Lockie Ferguson!
Lockie with a sharp bouncer angling into middle and leg. Tector ducks under it.
Back of a length, around off. Campher steers it towards third man and gets off the mark with a single.
Lands on a length, outside off. Curtis Campher leaves it alone.
Curtis Campher walks in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Lockie Ferguson comes back into the attack and gets a much-needed breakthrough for his tea. Great bowling change from Tom Latham as well and Andy McBrine departs after looking good for much more. Lockie Ferguson lands it on a length and outside off. Andy McBrine looks to guide it behind square on the off side. However, the ball catches a faint under-edge of his blade and goes back to the keeper. Tom Latham takes an easy catch and Ireland now lose their third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: A full delivery on off. Andy McBrine defends it off the front foot.
Lockie Ferguson is back on.
Looking very comfortable out there in the middle these two. Around off, this is cut away past the man at point for a single.
Fuller and at the stumps, Harry Tector heaves it towards wide long on for just another single.
Just a tad shorter and on off stump, on the fourth attempt McBrine does get it through cover-point and picks up a single.
No way through again. Around of, McBrine finds the man at covers yet again.
On a length and close to the off pole, this is tapped away straight towards cover-point.
On off stump, this is pushed out towards mid off.
Flatter delivery, cut away off the back foot towards deep point for one more.
On middle, this is pushed past the diving man at silly mid on for a single.

NOT OUT! Nicely flighted on leg stump, Andy McBrine makes a bit of room and looks to heave across the line. McBrine misses and the ball goes off the pads past off stump towards third man. The batters cross over as the fielding side go up in appeal. It is turned down but the review is taken. No spike on UltraEdge but Ball Tracking shows that both the impact and wickets are umpire's call and the on-field decision stands.

DRS Time! New Zealand have taken a review for LBW against Andy McBrine! The UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows that the impact is umpire's call. So the original decision of NOT OUT will stay.
Quicker and flatter, on off, McBrine cuts it straight to the man at backward point.
Flatter trajectory, around off, Tector waits for it and taps it through the cover region for a single.
Slower through the air and on a length on middle, Andy McBrine cuts it towards sweeper cover for one.
Fired in on off stump, McBrine drives it through mid off and picks up a single.
Flatter delivery, turning into middle and this is tickled away behind square on the leg side for a run.
Quicker again, on off, Tector just blocks it out from his crease.
Quicker delivery, on off stump, McBrine plays it off the back foot towards deep cover and collects a single. The 50 partnership is up between these two.
Around middle, this is worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Starts off with a shortish ball, turning into middle. Tector tucks it away towards short fine leg.

DRINKS! It has been quite an engrossing passage of play so far. New Zealand managed to take two early wickets sending both the Irish openers back to the pavilion. However, Andy McBrine and Harry Tector are batting well at the moment and Ireland would hope that they can continue and build a big partnership here. New Zealand though have quality in their ranks and would be looking to get some quick wickets to put Irish under more pressure. Michael Bracewell is into the attack now.
Back-to-back googlies to finish the over. On a length, turning away from middle and leg, McBrine keeps it out.
Here comes the googly, on the shorter side and on middle. McBrine hangs on the back foot and gets squared up as he edges it down towards point.
Missed opportunity from Andy McBrine and he will be disappointed. A floater down the leg side, McBrine just nudges it to the man at short fine leg instead of dispatching it past that man.
This is looped up on middle, McBrine drives it straight towards mid off.
Good running! Flatter delivery, on off, this is pushed to the left of the man at cover for a quick single.
Nicely tossed up, slower through the air and full on off stump. Tector pushes it out on the off side.
FOUR! Just a bit too full from Tickner and that's a glorious shot from Andy McBrine. This is on off stump, McBrine leans into the straight drive and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
WIDE! Hard length, well outside off and beyond the tramline. Wide called.

Great take from the keeper and there's half an appeal again this time for caught behind. This is angled down the leg side, McBrine looks for the flick but misses and the ball just clips his pads on the way to the keeper.
Stifled appeal but going down leg. Tickner comes from around the wicket and angles in a full ball onto the pads, Andy McBrine tries to clip it away but misses and gets hit on the back leg.
On a good length, around off, Tector hops and tucks it away 'round the corner for a single.
Length again, around middle and leg, clipped away towards the man at square leg.
Good early call of 'No' from Harry Tector. This is on a length and outside off, Tector plays it out with soft hands towards point.
FOUR! Great shot to end the over! Tossed up on off. Andy McBrine just stays in his crease and gets under it to smash it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Flighted delivery and around off. Andy McBrine defends it towards point.
On middle and fuller. Tector drives it to long on for a single.
Pushed quicker and flatter on middle. Tector blocks it out.

FOUR! Just short of the fielder in the deep and it runs away towards the fence. Tossed up on off. Tector with a lovely inside-out lofted drive towards deep extra-cover. The fielder at long off runs to his left and dives to catch it but it falls short and goes past him for a boundary.
Googly this time and Tector who backs away a bit, clips it towards short fine leg.
Lands on a length, on off. Andy McBrine pushes it back to the bowler.
Serves a length delivery, angling into the pads. Tector tucks it past square leg for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Tector drives it to covers.

Nicely bowled! Back of a length, around off. It nips away slightly after pitching and beats the outside edge of Tector's blade as he looks to defend. Actually, Tector does well to keep his bat inside the line of the ball there.
Fuller this time angling into leg. Andy McBrine flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Blair Tickner comes 'round the wicket and angles this shortish delivery on middle and leg. Andy McBrine looks to clip it but misses and gets hit high on his pads.
On the shorter side on middle. Andy McBrine goes back and clips it comfortably to deep square leg for a single.
Googly and it turns into middle and leg. Tector waits for it and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches it around off and it is a googly probably. Tector punches it off the back foot towards covers.
On the shorter side and outside off. Andy McBrine cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle and pushed quicker a bit.  Andy McBrine skips down the track and forces it wide of long on for a couple.
Tossed up on off. Tector drives it towards covers for an easy single.
Goes fuller on middle. Andy McBrine looks to drive but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
SIX! Lovely shot! Blair Tickner with a short delivery but it is outside off. Andy McBrine picks the length quickly and cuts it over deep point for a maximum. 50 up for Ireland as well!
Angles a fuller delivery on middle. Tector works it to mid-wicket for a single.
This one is outside off and on a length, Tector leaves it alone.
On a length, on off. Tector defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Lands on a length from 'round the wicket on middle. Andy McBrine defends it off the inside half of his blade towards mid-wicket for a single.
So just a single from the over. This one is fuller on off. Tector drives it without any timing back to the bowler.
A googly this time and it is tossed up as well. Tector though goes back and blocks it.
Tosses it up on off. Tector pushes it gently back to the bowler.
Pulls his length back and bowls it at 81.8 kph on middle. Tector defends it off the back foot.
Pushes it a bit quicker on off. Tector is solid in his front foot defence.
Tossed up on middle and leg. Andy McBrine defends it off the inside half of his blade. The ball goes towards the square leg region and a single is taken.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, we will see spin for the first time today as Ish Sodhi comes into the attack.
This is bowled halfway down the track and outside off, Tector just lets it through to the keeper. At the end of the first Powerplay, Ireland are 41/2!
FOUR! Easily done by Harry Tector. This is banged in short and at the body, Tector pulls it behind square on the leg side and picks up a boundary.
Looking to take it on Tector but misses it completely. This is pushed wider and the ball swings away as well, Tector dances down the track looking to go over mid off but doesn't connect.
Hard length this time, over middle stump. Tector looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the arm.
WIDE! Puts in some extra effort does Tickner but ends up angling it down the leg side. Wide called.
Back to over the wicket now for the right-hander, a good-length ball around off. Harry Tector hangs back and dabs it down towards the point region.
Starts from around the wicket and serves a length ball around the top of off. McBrine cuts it away behind point for a single.
We have a first bowling change of the game. Blair Tickner is into the attack now.
Length ball, angling into middle and leg, Tector defends it back towards the bowler.
This is pitched up on off, Tector presses forward and pushes it out towards mid off.
Good-length delivery, around off, Harry Tector watches it all the way through and makes a good leave.
Nicely driven but well fielded as well. This is pitched up on off, McBrine drives it to the left of the man at mid off who makes a good diving stop. The batters sneak in a quick single.
Just a touch fuller and on leg stump, McBrine is late on the shot but manages to keep it out on the leg side.
Back of a length, around off. This is punched off the back foot but straight towards point.
On a good length, pushed a bit wider and nipping in late. Tector makes a stylish leave.
FOUR! Squirted away onto the leg side! Full and angling in from around off, Harry Tector goes for the expansive drive but gets a thick inside edge. The ball goes past square leg and into the fence.
Probing length again, angling in from around off. Tector looks to defend off the front foot and the ball nips in and hits him on the thigh pad.
Wide! Trying to angle it into the pads but spills it down the leg side. Wide called.
Risky from McBrine! Good length, around off, McBrine opens the face of the bat and guides it just past the flying man at second slip. The ball goes towards third man and they get a single.
This is banged in short at 145.4 KPH and around off, McBrine bends his back and sways away from the line of the ball.
Excellent length, top of middle stump and over 140 clicks. Andy McBrine nudges it out towards short mid-wicket.
Probing length again from Henry, around off and nipping away again. Harry Tector plays inside the line of the ball. End of a productive over from Matt Henry.
A length ball, on off, this is defended out onto the off side.
Back of a length, over off stump. Tector gets on the back foot and keeps it down on the deck.

Gies full and straight, Harry Tector walks across his stumps and just about manages to get some bat on it. The ball runs away fine towards the fine leg fence but Lockie Ferguson does extremely well to run around to his right and put in the dive to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
Harry Tector walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent comeback delivery from Matt Henry and Ireland have now lost both their openers. Henry pulls back the length and bowls it on a tight line around off stump. Balbirnie gets pushes onto the back foot as he tries to keep it out on the off side. The ball nips away ever so slightly after pitching and catches the outside edge. Tom Latham takes a simple catch behind the stumps and Balbirnie has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Latham b Matt Henry

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That's trademark Andy Balbirnie. Just a bit fuller and around off, Balbirnie drives on the up and times it sweetly through covers for a boundary.
Pacy delivery, at 143.5 kph and angling in from off stump. Andy McBrine gets behind the line of the ball to make a solid block.
Top of the off stump line, around 142 clicks and solidly tapped away towards cover-point by McBrine.
This is angled into middle and leg, McBrine is late on the flick and gets a body blow into the ribs.
Lovely delivery! Comes from around the wicket and angles it in from outside off, this one nips away beautifully and beats the outside edge of McBrine's bat.
Back of a length, on off, Balbirnie stays leg side of the ball and tentatively pushes it through backward point for a single.
Good-length ball, over 142 clicks and angling into the body. Balbirnie hops and keeps it out.
Another dot ball to end the over and it will be a maiden! Length ball, slanted across the off stump. McBrine looks to play it on the up but gets beaten past the outside edge.
This is pitched up on off stump, McBrine leans in and pushes it out off the front foot.
Length again, around off and Andy McBrine looks to work it onto the leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
On a good length and over middle stump, McBrine defends it off the back foot.
Goes fuller this time, around off, this is firmly pushed towards the man at mid off.
Hard length from Henry, on middle and just nipping back in a touch. McBrine gets an inside edge back onto the pads.
Fuller in length and around off, McBrine pushes at it but gets an outside edge that goes well wide of second slip and towards third man. A single is taken.
Good length, around off and this is punched off the back foot towards cover-point.
Nicely bowled! Length ball, angling in from around off but just holds its line. McBrine tries to block but gets beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pitched up around off, McBrine presses forward and caresses it through extra cover for a boundary.

FOUR! Spicy short ball, bowled right around the helmet. Andy McBrine tries to take it on and almost falls back on his own stumps. McBrine does get a glove on it and the ball flies over the keeper's head, into the fine leg fence.
Pacy delivery, attacking the body of the batter. Andy Balbirnie manages to work it off his hips towards fine leg and picks up a run.
Short of a length and outside off, this is guided away to third man for a single.
A bit too straight from Henry and this is clipped away well in front of mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
And again! Tight line on off stump and the ball just shoots up off the surface, Balbirnie can do nothing about that one.
Peach of a delivery! Close to the top of off and nipping away a touch, Balbirnie gets completely squared up as the ball zips past the outside edge.
Perfect length, top of off stump and Andy Balbirnie gets right behind the line of the ball to make the block.

Bye! What happened here? Bowled on a good length, in that channel around off and the ball just nips very late, bamboozling Tom Latham behind the sticks. The ball goes through the gloves and towards third man as the batters cross over.
Leg bye! Fuller and angled onto the pads, McBrine misses the flick and gets it off the pads towards backward square leg. The batters sneak in a leg bye. Top first over from Lockie Ferguson.
That one had some serious heat behind it. At 146.2 clicks and angling into middle and off. McBrine gets squared up but manages to keep it out.
Switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander and delivers a shortish ball outside off. Andy McBrine leaves it alone.
Andy McBrine walks out at number 3.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Lockie Ferguson with a beauty of a delivery and Paul Stirling walks back for an early shower! Ferguson goes fuller and bowls it at almost 140 clicks. The ball nips back in sharply from the fourth stump line. Stirling looks to drive it through covers and ends up playing completely down the wrong line. The ball goes between bat and pad and castles into the stumps. Just the start New Zealand were looking for.
Goes fuller and around off, Stirling edges it down with soft hands towards third slip where the fielder makes a good diving stop.

Pacy delivery to start off proceedings by Lockie Ferguson. At 144 clicks and angling into the pads, Stirling falls over as he looks to clip it away and gets struck on the pads. There is an appeal for lbw but probably going down leg.
Lockie Ferguson to share the new ball with Matt Henry.
This is angled into middle and leg, Stirling with a tidy tuck towards square leg for a single. Six runs come off the first over then.
Short of a good length and well outside off. Paul Stirling lets it through to the keeper.
Keeps it around the top of off and Stirling presses forward to push it out on the off side.
Length this time, around the top of off, Stirling pushes it out towards covers.
No harm done! Henry goes full and straight, Stirling gets cramped for room and only manages to jam it out on the off side.
No ball! Length ball, on the fifth stump line and nipping in late. Paul Stirling leaves it alone and a no ball is called for overstepping. Free Hit coming up...

EDGED AND FOUR! Matt Henry starts off with a fullish ball outside off, Paul Stirling has a tentative push at it off the front foot and gets a thick outside edge. The ball races past the man at second slip and into the third man fence. Ireland are up and running.

We are done with the national anthems now! The two on-field umpires make their way out to the middle. New Zealand players also stride out to the middle. Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling are the openers for Ireland. Matt Henry has a brand new ball in his hand. Paul Stirling will take the strike and with two slips in place, Matt Henry comes charging in. Here we go...
The players from both sides are making their way out to the middle for the national anthems. It will be New Zealand's first and will be followed by the anthem of the home side, Ireland.

Kyle McCallan is down for the pitch report. He says that it is a typical Malahide pitch with a tinge of green on it. The pitch is a bit tacky underneath and there's some moisture over it. Mentions that the captain winning the toss will look to bowl first as there will be early help for the seamers.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Will Young, Tom Latham (C) (WK), Glenn Phillips, Henry Nicholls, Matt Henry, Michael Bracewell, Ish Sodhi, Blair Tickner, Lockie Ferguson.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Andy McBrine, Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), George Dockrell, Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Josh Little.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Tom Latham. New Zealand have elected to BOWL first.

Ireland have a settled team and they have shown already that they can go shoulder to shoulder with the big boys and now it's just a matter of doing that exact thing for a prolonged period of time. The hosts do well in T20Is but will need to be more patient when it comes to the 50-over format if they want to snatch a game or two off the Kiwis. Will the home side be able to use the conditions in their favor? Or will New Zealand prove to be just too strong an opposition for them? We'll find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
